exposure: Neonates with seizures due to hypocalcemia
Neonates with seizures due to perinatal asphyxia/hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy (HIE)
Neonates with seizures due to hypoglycemia
Neonates with seizures due to hyperbilirubinemia (kern icterus)
cohort: 72 neonates with seizures treated in the Ondokuz Mayis University Faculty of Medicine NICU.
finding: Neonatal seizures were most commonly caused by perinatal asphyxia/HIE and often responded to phenobarbital treatment.
